data.one_liner: In-app image and video picker with gallery, camera, crop, and filters.
data.what_it_does: Provides an in-app gallery, camera, and editing interface to pick, crop, filter, and adjust images and videos. Returns a list of picked files with support for mobile, web, and desktop platforms.
use_when: You want an in-app gallery and camera picker that matches your app theme rather than the system picker.
Users need to crop, filter, rotate, or markup images before uploading.
You need cross-platform media picking including mobile, web, and desktop.
avoid_when: You want the native OS image picker experience.
You are targeting WebAssembly (Wasm) where video playback features utilizing file system imports are incompatible.
strengths: Includes built-in cropping, filters, adjustments, markup, and camera controls.
Works across mobile, web, and desktop with a consistent UI.
No native code of its own, easing dependency management.
weaknesses: Video playback is limited or uses placeholders on certain platforms like Windows, Linux, and Web.
Requires platform-specific permission configuration in Info.plist and AndroidManifest.xml.
data.setup_notes: Requires adding camera, photo library, and microphone permissions in iOS Info.plist and Android AndroidManifest.xml, and a user-selected read-only entitlement on macOS.

alternatives.name: image_picker
alternatives.why_pick_it: Use it if you prefer the native operating system's image and video picker instead of a custom in-app UI.
